spec.name: bursty_offload__msps_only
spec.description: Sin/cos offload for an 8-channel sensor front end: bursts of 8 requests arrive as a Poisson process, 2 requests/us on average; p99 request latency must be <= 0.4 us. Max error <= 2^-10. Minimise LUTs + FFs.

spec.name: dds_sfdr__msps_only
spec.description: DDS phase-to-amplitude converter at 200 MS/s feeding a mixer through a 16-deep FIFO; the NCO must never stall (sustained 200 MS/s) and the synthesised tone needs SFDR >= 90 dBc. Max error <= 2^-13. Minimise LUTs.

spec.name: multiaxis_control__msps_only
spec.description: Shared sin/cos unit for a 16-axis motor-control loop: a 1 MHz control tick issues 32 requests at once (Park + inverse Park per axis); all 32 results must be back within 0.44 us of the tick (p99 over ticks). Max error <= 2^-12. Minimise LUTs + FFs.
